admin.description: Optional admin (test / bootstrap). DAO path should call via proposal execute.

max_nullifiers_per_mark.description: Default max nullifiers per MarkSpent call.

zk_proposals.description: Enable the zk proposal module (DAO DAO proposal-module mode).

anchor_registry.description: cw-vote-anchor registry; when set, proposals must take their root from it.

cast_circuit_key.description:
Expected 72-byte wasmvm circuit key. When set, its footer prefix is checked
(prover 0, curve 2, k 14) and it must equal `CircuitInfo { zk_id }` on chain.

cast_zkid.description: zkid of the stored vote-sdk `vote_proof` circuit.

dao.description: Defaults to the instantiator (dao-core when added via UpdateProposalModules).

quorum_bps.description: Turnout (yes + no + abstain) of total power in basis points.

threshold_bps.description: Yes share of (yes + no) in basis points that must be exceeded.

definitions.name: cosmwasm_std_hex_binary_HexBinary
definitions.description:
This is a wrapper around Vec<u8> to add hex de/serialization
with serde. It also adds some helper methods to help encode inline.

This is similar to `cosmwasm_std::Binary` but uses hex.
See also <https://github.com/CosmWasm/cosmwasm/blob/main/docs/MESSAGE_TYPES.md>.

circuit.description: A tally / decryption circuit with TALLY_INSTANCES public inputs.

committee.description: 32-byte FROST-Ed25519 group key of the election authority (t-of-n off chain).
